Third-Party Components

This directory contains third-party open-source software used by the
Energiefluss module.

   Project: LordGuenni/power-flow-card
   License: MIT
   License text: power-flow-card-MIT.txt

2. Lit

   License: BSD 3-Clause
   License text: lit-BSD-3-Clause.txt

The license of the Energiefluss module itself remains separate and is not
replaced by these third-party licenses.
